upright.blurb: Death brings about change and new beginnings. All things must come to an end, when one door closes another opens.
The fool looks over the cliff edge at the boundless potential of the future. The path is unclear, but you are prepared. Take the leap. Do not let fear hold you back.
Judgment looks within for absolution, let old wounds heal and start anew. Forgive yourself.
Justice represents truth, fairness and law, you may soon face a decision. Weigh your choices carefully.
The magician makes dreams reality. Now is the time to take action, don't hold back and seek out your desires.
Strength shines with patience and compassion. Trust your strength, you can accomplish anything you put your mind to.
Temperance finds tranquility amidst struggles. Your purpose is clear. In all things there is balance.
The Chariot gains victory through maintaining control of its surroundings. Stay Focused, your hard work will be rewarded.
The Devil's bindings are slipping away. Break the chains that bind you. Take back power in your life.
The Emperor sets out plans that he must see through, learn from your experiences and use it to advance forward.
The empress is caring and nurturing creating bonds with others, Now is the time to cultivate your connection to others.
The Hanged Man sacrifices himself for others. Taking action is not always the best solution, wait for the opportune moment.
The Hermit seeks knowledge gained through solitude. Reflect on yourself for the answers you seek.
The Hierophant encourages trust in tradition, be faithful of long trusted methods.
The high priestess understands and holds the answers to the deep unknowns revealing all in time. Listen to your heart. Your intuition will be your guide.
The Lovers are united in the knowledge they are stronger together. Remember the value of communication.
The Moon creates illusions, hidden truths are there to be discovered, search for the secrets to be unraveled.
The Star brings hope. You may have endured great hardship, but it only makes you shine brighter.
The Sun shines brightly on your path. Nothing can stop you now! Success is in your future.
The Tower crumbles, marking a radical change. The old ways are no longer useful, find other values to take their place.
The World is fulfillment, achievement, and completion. All the efforts that you have been putting in place are starting to pay off.
The Wheel of Fortune turns for everyone, evermore. Enjoy life to its fullest, what goes up must come down.

reversed.blurb: Death has neglected their duty, allowing things to fester. Evaluate approaching changes in life, trust you are taking the right steps going forward.
The fool ignores the warning signs and rushes ahead. Beware of rash decisions. Consider the outcome your actions could bring, and take caution on the path ahead.
Judgement cannot shed their self doubt. Learn from your mistakes.
Justice is blinded by chaos and lies. Actions have consequences, take a step back and gather your thoughts.
The magician hides the truth behind a distorted reality. Be wary of the manipulations of others, liars will not keep promises.
Strength has lost confidence and control of inner demons, don't let doubt cloud your mind.
Temperance has become unbalanced. All things are only good in moderation, examine which aspects of life are breaking the balance.
The Chariot has lost its way becoming stranded on the road. Come to terms with the fact you may not always be in control.
The Devil binds those who cannot see their freedom. There is always a way out of the darkness.
The Emperor rules with an iron fist. A lack of self-control could lead to loss of control entirely.
The empress gives until there is nothing left, do not set yourself alight to keep others warm.
The Hanged Man is sacrificed against his will. Now is the time for action, do not let your goals slip away from you.
The Hermit retreats, shutting out the world. Be wary of secluding yourself.
The Hierophant sacrificed progress in the name of tradition. It may be time to break conventions and encourage positive change.
The high priestess guards the way forward. Your inner voice is hidden from you, be careful of closing your mind to the truth.
The Lovers turn on each other as communication crumbles. Revaluate your relationships, do your values truly align?
The Moon hangs low creating darkness and confusion. You want to make progress, but you are not sure what is the right thing to do. Believe in yourself and move forward.
The Star has lost faith. Without hope we cannot overcome the challenges we face. Now is not the time to despair.
The Sun dims as storm clouds gather. Temper your expectations, certain setbacks could damage your optimism.
The Tower is a harbinger of destruction. What you relied on will no longer be there for you. It is time for you to become more self-reliant.
The World strays from its path before its final goals are met. Though you have many accomplishments, something is missing. Don't end your journey too soon.
The Wheel of Fortune returns to the beginning. Greater forces are at work here, don't fret. things will get better eventually.
